description: Remove a paper from a collection, addressed by collection_id OR collection_name. MUTATES (the paper stays in your library; it's only removed from this collection). Idempotent. Requires SF_API_KEY.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv ID of the paper to remove from the collection.

collection_id.description: UUID of the collection. Provide this OR collection_name.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection. Provide this OR collection_id.

name: remove_from_collection

action.description: Machine label: saved | no_change | removed | liked | created | updated | deleted.

title: Remove from Collection
